sql:
SELECT a.account_id, (MAX(d.A11) - d.A11) AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND c.birth_date IN (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date)
    FROM client
)
AND d.A11 = (
    SELECT MIN(A11)
    FROM district
)
GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A11
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 1
